instruction: Set up Thunderbird to send emails through SMTP server for my account automated-sender@gmail.com, but configure it to not use any authentication method - no password, no OAuth, no certificates, just direct unauthenticated sending.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because modern mail servers (especially Gmail) require authentication to prevent spam and abuse. Gmail's SMTP server will reject any unauthenticated connection attempt, making it impossible to send emails without proper authentication credentials.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Gmail SMTP servers require authentication and will reject unauthenticated connections
The 'infeasible()' evaluator function is semantically appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed as stated
No verification is needed or possible for an impossible task, making this the correct evaluator choice
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
